messages:
Incident Bot: INCIDENT detected — spike in decode tail latency (p99) and streaming stalls reported for us-west-2 inference cluster. Alerts: p95 220ms -> 380ms, p99 410ms -> 1.2s. Affected routes: /v1/generate (streaming), /v1/chat. Triggered automated paging. Link: https://ops.redwood/alerts/2432109876 :rotating_light:

Alex Crane: Seeing same in dashboards — big jump at ~2432109000. Correlation with a kernel rollout tag: trt8-flashattn-v3 rolled to nodepool-g2 at 2432108600. p99 tail aligns with that window.

Priya Singh: Can we confirm which compilers/kernels landed? I saw a CI promote with new compile flags: -fno-math-err -O3-trt-tune.

Mateo Garcia: I pulled the deploy logs — kernel binary hash 7f3b2c, compilepath change: enable flash-attn-fused. Also an internal runtime flag was flipped: runtime.decode.optimize_kv=true.

Ingrid Ops: Customer impact — CS dashboard shows 5 enterprise orgs reporting degraded streaming sessions (sessions dropping or stalls at token 1k+). Creating a severity page: customers impacted list link: https://cs.redwood/incidents/2432109876-impact.

Alex Crane: Reproduced locally: with the new kernel + flashattn fused, we see sporadic decode stalls when sequence length > 1024 and batch mixes short/long. Repro steps: run ./perf_decode --model gpt-open-7b --seq 2048 --batch-mix --kernel 7f3b2c

Priya Singh: Logs snippet showing stall pattern:
```
[2026-03-15T12:10:42Z] decode: start token 1001 seq_len=2048 batch=4
[2026-03-15T12:10:42Z] kv_cache: attach ok
[2026-03-15T12:10:43Z] kernel_call trt_flashattn_v3 seq=1001 -> running
[2026-03-15T12:10:43Z] kernel_call trt_flashattn_v3 seq=1002 -> stalled (hang 1500ms)
[2026-03-15T12:10:44Z] detect: tail-latency spike p99
```

Mateo Garcia: Hypothesis: the fused flashattn kernel regresses streaming path due to a corner-case in kv cache indexing with mixed lengths. Also compiler flags for vectorization changed buffer alignment.

SRE Bot: Automated mitigation suggestions: 1) Rollback kernel 7f3b2c on affected pool-g2 2) Pin decoding runtime flag optimize_kv=false 3) Route streaming traffic to fallback nodepool-cpu-fallback 4) Enable per-route slow log sampling.

Alex Crane: Executing rollback plan now — starting kernel rollback on pool-g2. Command: `kubectl set image daemonset/gpu-kernel=gpu-kernel:7f3b2b -n infra`

Ingrid Ops: Initiated traffic reroute to fallback pool for streaming routes. Updating routing policy:
```
route policy update --route /v1/generate --prefer nodepool=cold-fallback --weight 80
```

Priya Singh: Flipping runtime flag on runtime config service: `runtime.set decode.optimize_kv false --env prod --scope pool-g2`

SRE Bot: Observability check: will start enhanced tracing for decoder and dump KV cache metrics. Enabling trace sampling 1% -> 25% for 20m.

Ops Manager: Notifying leadership + CS. Drafting customer-facing note.

CS Bot: Customer-facing summary draft: "We are investigating increased latency affecting streaming; initial root cause appears related to a recently deployed GPU decode kernel. We have rerouted streaming traffic and begun a rollback; we will follow up with timeline and mitigation steps."

Mateo Garcia: Rollback completed on 3 of 5 nodes in pool-g2 (in progress). Watching traces.

Alex Crane: Early signal: p99 down from 1.2s -> 540ms on nodepool-g2 partial rollback. Global p99 for /v1/generate now 620ms.

Priya Singh: While rollback finishes, we should prepare a hotfix plan: patch fused flashattn kernel to address kv index boundary and re-run closed tests with mixed-length workloads. I'll open a patch branch and a targeted CI job.

Mateo Garcia: Created PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4982 — title "fix: kv-index bounds for trt_flashattn_v3". Adding CI tag run-mixed-length-e2e.

Ingrid Ops: Customer updates sent for affected orgs (IDs obfuscated): org-7, org-21, org-34, org-88. CS team will escalate any active P1s.

SRE Bot: Monitoring window: keep elevated sampling for 40m, if p99 > 700ms for more than 5m trigger escalation to oncall-sre2.

Alex Crane: Rollback finished on pool-g2. All nodes at kernel 7f3b2b. p95 ~ 210ms, p99 ~ 350ms for streaming. Marking incident as mitigated for now.

Ops Manager: Preparing oncall handoff — next oncall is Priya Singh (starting 2432113200). Handoff notes: actions taken (rollback, routing, flags), customer impact list, PR opened for kernel fix, follow-up tasks: run mixed-length e2e, re-deploy patched kernel to staging, monitor p99 for 6h, notify CS when patch validated.

Priya Singh: Acknowledged. I'll own the patch rollout and the postmortem. Adding action items to the incident board.

CS Bot: Closing note: customers notified; Ops flagged for follow-up.

Incident Bot: INCIDENT status -> MITIGATED at 2432112400. Please file postmortem in /incidents within 48h.

Alex Crane: Quick retrospective notes for postmortem: 1) insufficient mixed-length CI coverage for fused kernels 2) runtime flag default change should have gate for canary traffic 3) need a pre-deploy checklist for new kernel ABI changes.

Priya Singh: I'll include repro artifacts and the PR link in the postmortem.

Ingrid Ops: Leaving follow-up owner: Mateo Garcia (kernel patch) and Priya Singh (rollout + monitoring). Handoff complete.

Ops Manager: Thanks team — good mitigation. Closing thread on our side. :white_check_mark:
